notes: This contract selects the 2025 Requirements Lab restore-control requirements exercised by Umbra's embedded development profile. It covers an accepted restore request, all-member initiation, post-save state rollback, completion/failure/abort callbacks, status reporting, a bounded resignation/failure boundary, and five lifetime/state regressions: restoring a saved temporal image must not let a post-save MessageRetractionHandle alias fresh post-restore traffic; must restore a pre-save live TSO interaction payload plus its recipient ledger after a post-save Retract made that record terminal; must preserve a pre-save terminal tombstone as MessageCanNoLongerBeRetracted rather than an invalid handle; must restore saved logical time and actual lookahead after post-save mutations; and must retain a saved deferred lookahead-decrease target so the restored time window follows the same later grant behavior. It explicitly does not claim complete HLA save/restore semantics, durable external persistence, timed restore, general post-restore handle remapping, transport, protected review, package support, or conformance.
